Incorporate vector and host parameters in the entomological model

Source: R/model_params.R
build_model_obj.Rd

build_model_obj This function incorporates defined vector and host parameters in the entomological model of mosquito oviposition cycle and builds a comprehensive object containing all model parameters. Additional parameters are calculated and included in the object: the mosquito death rate while host seeking and the availability rate of each host type (humans and animals) in the absence of interventions. The function should be applied only on list objects created by the package functions def_vector_params and def_host_params. Functionality using other customized objects is not guaranteed.

Activity patterns are not stored in the model object; pass them directly to calculate_exposure() where they are used.

Usage

build_model_obj(vec_p, hosts_p)

Arguments

vec_p

object containing vector-specific entomological parameters created with the function def_vector_params

hosts_p

object containing host-specific entomological parameters created with the function def_host_params

Value

list object containing the following components:

  • vec_params: object with mosquito-specific entomological parameters (use function def_vector_params to generate object)

  • host_params: object with host-specific entomological parameters (use function def_host_params to generate object). In addition to previously-defined parameters, it contains:

    • muvA: mosquito death rate while host seeking (per day)

    • alphai: per-individual-host availability to mosquitoes (per day), for humans and animals

Author

Monica Golumbeanu, monica.golumbeanu@swisstph.ch

Examples

# Retrieve the species-specific entomological parameters for An. gambiae
gambiae_vec_p = def_vector_params("Anopheles gambiae ss/coluzzii")
# Retrieve the host-specific entomological parameters
gambiae_hosts_p = def_host_params()
# Build model object
model_p = build_model_obj(gambiae_vec_p, gambiae_hosts_p)
print(model_p)
